args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) is failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running **v2.3.1** (the latest deploy) in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- From the deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy; v2.2.9 was healthy but older).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. Verified: all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy", describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

Note: the rollback to v2.3.0 is a previously-healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
